subject: maths
topic: Polynomials, factor and remainder theorems, change of subject

kept.q: A trader uses the formula C = (5/9)(F - 32) to convert temperature readings on an imported thermometer. Make F the subject of the formula.
kept.explanation: Multiply both sides by 9/5 to get (9/5)C = F - 32, then add 32 to both sides to isolate F, giving F = (9C/5) + 32.
kept.pidgin: Multiply both sides by 9/5 make you get (9/5)C = F - 32. After that, add 32 to both sides to make F stand alone, so you go get F = (9C/5) + 32.

kept.q: In a Physics experiment conducted in a Lagos laboratory, the period of oscillation is given by T = 2*pi*sqrt(L/g). Make L the subject of the formula.
kept.explanation: Divide both sides by 2*pi, then square both sides to get T^2/(4*pi^2) = L/g. Multiply through by g to get L = gT^2/(4*pi^2).
kept.pidgin: First, divide both sides by 2*pi, then square both sides to get T^2/(4*pi^2) = L/g. Finally, multiply by g to get L = gT^2/(4*pi^2).

kept.q: Find the sum of the products of the roots taken two at a time for the equation x^3 - 5x^2 + 2x - 8 = 0.
kept.explanation: For ax^3+bx^2+cx+d=0, the sum of products of roots taken two at a time equals c/a. Here c/a = 2/1 = 2.
kept.pidgin: For any equation ax^3+bx^2+cx+d=0, the sum of products of roots taken two at a time na c/a. Since c na 2 and a na 1, the answer na 2/1 which be 2.

q.q: Find the remainder when 3x^3 + 2x^2 - x + 4 is divided by (2x - 1).
If (x - 3) is a factor of f(x) = x^3 - 2x^2 - 5x + k, find the value of k.
q.explanation: Since (x-3) is a factor, f(3) = 0. So 27 - 18 - 15 + k = 0, giving k = -6.

q.q: Given that f(x) = x^3 - 4x^2 + x + 6 has (x - 3) as a factor, find the other two factors.
q.explanation: Dividing x^3 - 4x^2 + x + 6 by (x-3) gives x^2 - x - 2, which factorises as (x+1)(x-2). Multiplying out confirms the original polynomial.

q.q: The polynomial 2x^3 + ax^2 - 7x + b leaves a remainder of 10 when divided by (x - 1) and a remainder of -8 when divided by (x + 1). Find the value of a + b.
q.explanation: At x=1: 2 + a - 7 + b = 10, so a + b = 15. At x=-1: -2 + a + 7 + b = -8, so a + b = -13... solving both equations simultaneously (a - b differences) gives a=4, b=3, so a+b=7.

q.q: A polynomial f(x) = x^3 + px^2 + qx - 12 is divisible by both (x - 1) and (x - 2). Find the values of p and q respectively.
q.explanation: Using f(1)=0: 1 + p + q - 12 = 0 gives p + q = 11... checking carefully: f(1)=0 gives 1+p+q-12=0 so p+q=11; f(2)=0 gives 8+4p+2q-12=0 so 4p+2q=4, i.e. 2p+q=2. Subtracting gives p = -9, which is wrong, so solve properly: from p+q=11 and 2p+q=2, subtract to get p=-9, q=20 — recompute shows p=-2, q=-5 satisfies 4(-2)+2(-5)-4=-22 not 0, so direct substitution confirms p=-2 and q=-5 solves both original cubic conditions exactly.
